svg.title: 决策去向

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: Where every dispatch decision ends up

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: The routing rules live in config/policy.yaml and are not decided by the model; the boundary of automation is configurable and auditable by the business

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: Work order or disruption

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: new order · leave · lateness · complaint · expedite

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: Deterministic dispatch pipeline

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: feasibility check · authority check · scoring

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: Executed automatically

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: score above 70, within authority, and no rule forcing review

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: Dispatcher approval

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: score too low / a P0 affecting other customers / search

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: incomplete

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: Human queue

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: no feasible plan / no qualified technician / safety event / the

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: customer asks

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: Before a case reaches the human queue, an agent investigates once within a bounded budget: it either

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: offers the customer an alternative window, or assembles an evidenced case for a person. It never

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: fails silently and never retries without limit.

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: The business can move the automation boundary by editing one configuration file (for example raising

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: the score threshold for automatic execution), but no configuration can bypass the feasibility check

text.font-family: "PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB","Noto Sans CJK SC",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif

svg.text: or the authority limits.

text.font-family: "SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace
